subject.title: Chula Vista Elementary School District Board, Seat 1

text: Academic Excellence – Student Safety – Parent Engagement

Every child deserves more than an education. They deserve the opportunity to discover their potential, feel safe when they walk through the school gates, and be inspired to dream bigger than they ever thought possible.

Jorge Balvaneda is a father, Chula Vista resident, and community leader, whose own children attended CVESD schools. Jorge is running for School Board because he believes our children are our community’s greatest responsibility - and our greatest hope for the future.

Jorge Balvaneda will advocate for parent engagement because families are our children’s first and most important teachers. Parents deserve a voice, clear communication, and a genuine partnership with the schools that help shape their children’s future.

Jorge Balvaneda will champion academic excellence where every child can build a strong foundation in reading, writing, math, science, and critical thinking. We must ensure students and teachers have the support, resources, and opportunities they need to succeed in the classroom and beyond.

Jorge Balvaneda will prioritize student safety because children learn best when they feel secure, supported, and cared for. Schools should be places where students can focus on learning, building confidence, and developing the skills needed to thrive.

When parents place their children on a school bus or drop them off each morning, they trust that their schools will help them learn, protect their well-being, and prepare them for life. That trust must be earned every day.

Jorge Balvaneda has spent decades running programs involving leadership, financial stewardship, risk management, and emergency preparedness. As a certified leadership coach and Latino Leader of Influence award recipient, Jorge has dedicated his career to developing people, strengthening communities, and making difficult decisions with integrity and accountability. Those experiences have prepared him to serve our students, families, and community.

Jorge Balvaneda’s commitment has always been rooted in service: helping others, strengthening communities, and creating opportunities for future generations. Together, we can build schools where every child is challenged to achieve, protected from harm, and supported by a community that believes in them.
Jorge Balvaneda humbly asks for your vote so, together, we can put children first and create a brighter future for every student.
Please visit www.jorgebalvaneda.com for more information.

text: As your Governing Board member, I have consistently voted for policies that strengthened school safety and security, increased academic achievement, and ensured every child has access to the opportunities they deserve. I put students first. My leadership is grounded in experience, with over 26 years of federal civil service and military service. I hold a bachelor’s degree in business administration, and a master’s degree in organizational leadership. I understand the importance of responsible budgeting, transparency, and accountability. I bring those principles to every decision I make on behalf of our district. I am proud to be endorsed by Chula Vista Educators.

Chula Vista is more than where I live, it is my home. Being raised between Tijuana and Chula Vista and growing up bilingual and bicultural, has shaped my appreciation for the diversity and strength of our community and has inspired my commitment to ensuring every student feels valued, supported, and empowered to succeed.

My passion for public education is deeply personal. When my son began Transitional Kindergarten, my husband, a 22-year Marine Corps veteran, was diagnosed with terminal cancer. He passed away shortly after our son completed TK. During that difficult time, our teachers, school staff, and Chula Vista School District community embraced our family with extraordinary compassion and support. They reminded me that schools do far more than educate children, they provide hope, stability, and belonging. Their kindness inspired me to serve the district that gave so much to my family.

As a Board Member, I have delivered results by supporting increased funding for our classrooms while reducing district office expenditures, strengthening campus safety through partnerships with the Chula Vista Police Department and expanded security cameras at every school. I have increased academic interventions for struggling students, expanded after-school and summer learning opportunities, and protected funding for visual and performing arts and special education programs.

I believe every child deserves a safe, high-quality education, regardless of their background or circumstances. I will continue to champion academic excellence, fiscal responsibility, transparency, and strong partnerships with families and our community.
I am committed to continue working to ensure every student in the Chula Vista Elementary School District has the opportunity to learn, grow, and achieve their full potential.

text: For more than thirty years, I have devoted my life to educating, uplifting, and advocating for children. I have had the privilege of serving as a teacher, principal, district leader, university faculty member, arts educator, grant writer, and community partner. Every role has strengthened my belief in one simple truth: hope and opportunity belong to every child.

My motivation is deeply personal. I am a Head Start alum, a trained musician who learned early how the arts transform lives, a mother of four who raised her children in Chula Vista schools, and a grandmother of eight who wants every child, no matter their background, identity, or circumstance, to feel seen, supported, and safe in our classrooms.

My qualifications reflect decades of hands-on leadership and proven results. I have led award winning schools, built celebrated arts programs, secured national grants, coached administrators, and guided systems-level improvements across diverse communities. I have been honored as the Association of California Schools Administrators’ Region 18 Principal of the Year. I understand policy, budgets, Ed Code, and the complex realities educators face. Most importantly, I understand children and their brilliance, their challenges, and their limitless potential.

I stand for academic excellence, safe and welcoming schools, responsible fiscal stewardship, arts access, educator support, and meaningful partnerships with families and community organizations. I stand for transparency, collaboration, and decisions grounded in both data and humanity. But above all, I stand for hope and opportunity for every child.

I am running because I believe in our students. I believe in our educators. I believe in our community. And I believe that together, we can create schools where every child’s future is bright, possible, and filled with hope.
I would be honored to earn your vote so I can continue to use my voice to serve our schools and our community.
Website: drdebramclaren.com
